sentences.en: PRESENTER: This evening we're delighted to welcome Dan Beagle, who's just written a book on looking for and finding food in the wild.
sentences.zh: PRESENTER: 今晚，我们非常荣幸地邀请到丹·比格尔（Dan Beagle），他刚刚出版了一本关于在野外寻找和采集食物的书。

sentences.en: He's going to tell us everything we need to know about picking wild mushrooms.
sentences.zh: 他将为我们详细介绍采摘野生蘑菇所需了解的一切知识。

sentences.en: DAN: Thank you very much.
sentences.zh: DAN: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: Well, I need to start by talking about safety.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我首先要谈的是安全问题。

sentences.en: You really need to know what you're doing because some mushrooms are extremely poisonous.
sentences.zh: 你真的必须清楚自己在做什么，因为有些蘑菇具有极强的毒性。

sentences.en: Having said that, once you know what to look for, it's really worth doing for the amazing variety of mushrooms available • which you can't get in the shops.
sentences.zh: 话虽如此，但一旦你知道该寻找什么，这项活动就非常值得尝试——毕竟野生蘑菇种类极其丰富，而这些品种在商店里根本买不到。

sentences.en: But of course, you have to be very careful and that's why I always say you should never consume mushrooms picked by friends or neighbours - always /12 remember that some poisonous mushrooms look very similar to edible ones and it's easy for people to get confused.
sentences.zh: 当然，你必须格外谨慎，因此我始终强调：切勿食用朋友或邻居采摘的蘑菇——请务必牢记，一些有毒蘑菇与可食用蘑菇外观极为相似，人们很容易混淆。

sentences.en: The other thing to avoid is mushrooms /12 growing beside busy roads for obvious reasons.
sentences.zh: 另一点需要避免的是：生长在繁忙道路旁的蘑菇，原因显而易见。

sentences.en: But nothing beats the taste of freshly picked mushrooms - don't forget that the ones in the shops are often several days old and past their best.
sentences.zh: 但没有什么能比得上新鲜采摘蘑菇的美味——别忘了，商店里售卖的蘑菇往往已存放数日，早已过了最佳食用期。

sentences.en: There are certain ideas about wild mushrooms that it's important to be aware of.
sentences.zh: 关于野生蘑菇，有一些常见观念，我们必须有所了解。

sentences.en: Don't listen to people who tell you that it's only OK to eat mushrooms that /14 are pale or dull - this is completely untrue.
sentences.zh: 不要轻信那些告诉你‘只有颜色浅淡或暗淡的蘑菇才可食用’的说法——这完全是错误的。

sentences.en: Some edible mushrooms are bright.
sentences.zh: 有些可食用蘑菇色泽鲜亮。

sentences.en: red, for example.
sentences.zh: 例如红色的。

sentences.en: Personally, I prefer mushrooms cooked but it won't do you any harm to eat them uncooked in salads - it's not necessary to peel them.
sentences.zh: 我个人更喜欢将蘑菇烹熟后食用，但将其生食（如拌入沙拉）也无害——而且完全无需去皮。

sentences.en: Another thing you should remember is that you can't tell if a mushroom is safe to eat by its smell - some of the most deadly mushrooms have no smell and taste quite nice, apparently.
sentences.zh: 还有一点需谨记：绝不能单凭气味判断蘑菇是否可食——某些剧毒蘑菇毫无气味，且据说味道还相当不错。

sentences.en: Finally, just because deer or squirrels eat a particular mushroom /14 doesn't mean that you can.
sentences.zh: 最后，请注意：鹿或松鼠吃了某种蘑菇，并不意味着人类也能食用。

sentences.en: Of course, mushroom picking is associated with the countryside but if you haven't got a car, your local park can be a great place to start.
sentences.zh: 当然，采蘑菇通常与乡村环境相关联；但如果你没有汽车，本地公园其实也是绝佳的入门地点。

sentences.en: There are usually a range of habitats where mushrooms grow, such as playing fields and wooded areas.
sentences.zh: 公园内通常具备多种适宜蘑菇生长的栖息环境，例如运动场和林地区域。

sentences.en: But you need to be there first thing in the morning, as there's likely a be a lot of competition - not just from people but wildlife too.
sentences.zh: 但你必须一早便前往，因为竞争十分激烈——不仅来自其他采摘者，也来自野生动物。

sentences.en: The deer often get the best mushrooms in my local park.
sentences.zh: 在我家附近的公园里，鹿群常常抢先采走最优质的蘑菇。

sentences.en: a If you're a complete beginner, I wouldn't recommend going alone or relying on photos in a book, even the one I've written!
sentences.zh: a 如果你是彻头彻尾的新手，我并不建议你独自前往，也不要仅依赖书籍中的图片（哪怕是我写的那本！）。

sentences.en: There are some really good phone apps for identifying mushrooms, but you can't always rely on getting a good signal in the middle of a wood.
sentences.zh: 目前市面上有一些非常优秀的手机应用程序可用于识别蘑菇，但在树林深处，你未必总能获得良好的信号。

sentences.en: If possible, you should go with a group led by an.
sentences.zh: 如果条件允许，你最好加入由专业人士带领的采摘小组。

sentences.en: expert - you'll stay safe and learn a lot that way.
sentences.zh: 这样既能确保安全，又能学到大量实用知识。

sentences.en: Conservation is a really important consideration and you must follow a few basic rules.
sentences.zh: 生态保护是一项至关重要的考量因素，你必须遵守几条基本规则。

sentences.en: You should never pick all the mushrooms in one area - collect only enough for your own needs.
sentences.zh: 切勿将某一区域内的所有蘑菇全部采光——只采摘满足自身需求的数量即可。

sentences.en: Be very careful that you don't trample on young mushrooms or other plants.
sentences.zh: 务必小心，避免踩踏幼嫩的蘑菇或其他植物。

sentences.en: And make sure you don't pick any mushrooms that are endangered and protected by law.
sentences.zh: 同时，请确保不采摘任何受法律保护、濒临灭绝的蘑菇种类。

sentences.en: There's been a decline in some varieties of wild mushrooms in this part of the country.
sentences.zh: 本地区部分野生蘑菇品种数量已明显减少。

sentences.en: Restaurants are becoming more interested in locally sourced food like wild mushrooms, but the biggest problem is that so many new houses have been built in this area in the last ten years.
sentences.zh: 餐厅正日益关注本地食材，例如野生蘑菇；但最大的问题在于，过去十年中，本地区新建了大量住宅。

sentences.en: And more water is being taken from rivers and reservoirs because of this, and mushroom habitats have been destroyed.
sentences.zh: 由此导致从河流和水库中抽取的水量增加，蘑菇的自然栖息地也因此遭到破坏。

sentences.en: Anyway, a word of advice on storing mushrooms.
sentences.zh: 好了，再给大家一点关于储存蘑菇的建议。

sentences.en: Collect them in a brown paper a bag and as soon as you get home, put them in the fridge.
sentences.zh: 请用棕色纸袋收集蘑菇，一回到家，立即放入冰箱。

sentences.en: They'll be fine for a couple of days, but it's best to cook them as soon as possible - after washing them really carefully first, of course.
sentences.zh: 它们在冰箱中可保存两三天，但最好尽快烹饪——当然，烹饪前务必彻底清洗。

sentences.en: So everybody knows what a mushroom tastes like, right?
sentences.zh: 那么，大家都知道蘑菇是什么味道，对吧？

sentences.en: Well, you'll be surprised by the huge variety of wild mushrooms there are.
sentences.zh: 事实上，野生蘑菇的口味种类之丰富，定会让你大吃一惊。

sentences.en: Be adventurous!
sentences.zh: 大胆尝试吧！

sentences.en: They're great in so many dishes - stir fries, risottos, pasta.
sentences.zh: 它们适用于众多菜肴——炒菜、意大利烩饭、意面等。

sentences.en: But just be aware that some people can react badly to certain varieties so it's a good idea not to eat huge quantities to begin with.
sentences.zh: 但请注意：某些人可能对特定品种产生不良反应，因此初尝时不宜大量食用。

sentences.en: OK, so now I'm going to show you
sentences.zh: 好的，接下来我将为大家展示
